title: Full faithfulness of lisse restriction on a parameter-root limit
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a characteristic-$p$ field $k$ and a finite norm-topological extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Put $C_E(P)=C(P,E)$ for all profinite sets $P$ using all continuous maps, and use its pulled-back coefficient rings and internal modules [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $Y$ be a regular separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $B\to Y$ an affine etale chart, and $V(t_1\cdots t_r)$ a reduced strict normal crossings divisor whose branches on $B$ are precisely $V(t_d)$ [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. For an affine pro-etale $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], set
$$T=\operatorname{Spec}\left(\varinjlim_{(n,p)=1}R[x_{d,n}]_{1\le d\le r}/(x_{d,n}^n-t_d)_d\right),\qquad T^\circ=T\times_B B[1/(t_1\cdots t_r)].$$
The index is positive integers prime to $p$ ordered by divisibility, with $x_{d,n}\mapsto x_{d,m}^{m/n}$ for $n\mid m$. A lisse module means pro-etale locally finite free over the pulled-back $C_E$ [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. If $j:T^\circ\hookrightarrow T$ is the open inclusion, then for all finite-rank lisse $C_{E,T}$-modules $\mathcal N,\mathcal N'$ the restriction map
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{C_{E,T}}(\mathcal N,\mathcal N')\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{C_{E,T^\circ}}(j^*\mathcal N,j^*\mathcal N')$$
is a bijection. These bijections commute with pro-etale base change of $U$. They include the empty parameter list, rank zero, and the empty chart. No assertion about extending objects from $T^\circ$ is made.
